heading.en: King Benjamin addresses his people—He recounts the equity, fairness, and spirituality of his reign—He counsels them to serve their Heavenly King—Those who rebel against God will suffer anguish like unquenchable fire. About 124 B.C.
heading.sm: Ua lauga atu le Tupu o Peniamina i lona nuu—Ua toe faamatala mai e ia le tutusa, le sa'o, ma le faaleagaga o lana nofoaiga—Ua fautuaina e ia i latou ia auauna atu i lo latou Tupu Faalelagi—O i latou o e e fouvale faatautee i le Atua o le a mafatia i le mafatia e pei o le afi e lē matineia. E tusa o le 124 T.L.M.

w.en: out of the land of Jerusalem,
from the presence of the Lord,
